content: In this paper we present NLI-PT, a dataset collected for Portuguese NLI. The dataset is made freely available for research purposes. With the goal of unifying learner data collected from various sources, listed in Section "Collection methodology" , we applied a methodology which has been previously used for the compilation of language variety corpora BIBREF5 . The data was converted to a unified data format and uniformly annotated at different linguistic levels as described in Section "Preprocessing and annotation of texts" . To the best of our knowledge, NLI-PT is the only Portuguese dataset developed specifically for NLI, this will open avenues for research in this area.
